summary: Verified the effect-only ability roll fix on the character sheet. All 5 requested flows PASS: (1) Once-Per-Turn 'Fireball' with no linked stat + Damage 2d6 -> Use button reads 'Roll Damage', modal shows large total (rolled 4, in range 2..12), verdict 'DAMAGE', 'Rolls: [3, 1]' breakdown, no 'Target ≥' line, and no effect-total testID. (2) Cycled to Healing 1d8+2 -> button 'Roll Healing', verdict 'HEALING', total 8 in valid 3..10 range. (3) Linked stat STRENGTH (stat-picker-row-1) -> button 'Use Ability', rolled d20=10 vs Target ≥ 15 with verdict 'FAILURE' (linked-stat flow intact). (4) Empty ability (no stat, no effect) -> Use is a silent no-op, no dice modal opened. (5) Regressions confirmed: stat-main-STR opens d20 modal, HP -/+ and hp-heart-0 render, and character list shows '20 / 20' HP text. No deprecated Expo packages, red screens, or console errors observed during flow.
test_report_links: Playwright script executed inline via mcp_browser_automation on preview URL
critical_code_review_comments: AbilityCard use-button label logic (AbilityCard.tsx:181-188) and useAbility() dispatch (character/[id].tsx:128-155) correctly split three cases: no-op, effect-only, and d20+effect. Safe and readable.
DiceRollModal onlyEffect path (DiceRollModal.tsx:64-80, 119-149) reuses dice-result-number testID for the total and hides target/verdict success/fail styling as designed.
character/[id].tsx is 707 lines, close to the 700-line guideline — consider splitting AbilitySection/AddButton into their own files in a future refactor (not blocking).

rca_of_issue: N/A - verification only. The fix correctly handles: (a) neither stat nor effect => early return; (b) no target but effect present => setRoll({label, effect}) triggering effect-only branch in DiceRollModal; (c) both => full d20-vs-target with effect on success.
